cases.title: A low product triggers only an alert to the owner, nothing else
cases.given: A Stock tab where one product is below its minimum
then: The only effects are one email to the owner and a red row
No order, no other recipient, no other tab is created or changed

cases.title: A check on 500 product rows finishes without error
cases.given: A Stock tab with a header row and 500 product rows with Product, Quantity and Minimum
then: It finishes without error within the Apps Script run-time limit
Every row was read

cases.title: Two low products and one above give an email with exactly those two and two red rows
cases.given: 3 products: A at its minimum, B below its minimum, C above its minimum
then: One email lists exactly A and B with name, quantity and minimum
The rows of A and B are red
The row of C is not red

cases.title: A failed email send makes at most 3 attempts and keeps the red rows
cases.given: One low product and an email sender that always fails
then: The sender is called at most 3 times
The low row is still red

cases.title: A check changes no values and emails only the owner
cases.given: A Stock tab with known Quantity and Minimum values and at least one low product
then: Every Quantity and Minimum is unchanged
No row is deleted
The email recipient is only the sheet owner's address

cases.title: The daily trigger runs the check at 08:00 with the laptop off
cases.given: The daily trigger is installed and one product is below its minimum
then: The alert email arrives by 09:00 the next morning

cases.title: A row with a blank or text Quantity or Minimum is skipped and listed as a problem
cases.given: 3 rows: one with Quantity blank, one with Minimum set to "abc", one valid and low
then: The valid row is in the alert
The other two are listed under "Rows with problems"
The other two are not in the low list

cases.title: End to end: one product exactly at its minimum gives one email with only that product
cases.given: A sheet with 3 products, one exactly at its minimum and two above
then: One email arrives that lists only that product

cases.title: A check started by hand on the real list matches what the user sees
cases.given: The user's real product list and no alert email sent yet today
cases.when: The user starts the check from the custom menu
then: The email lists exactly the products the user sees at or below their minimum

cases.title: Low means at or below the minimum
cases.when: Each is tested for low stock
then: 4 is low
5 is low
6 is not low

cases.title: No low products and no problems means no email
cases.given: Every product above its minimum and no problem rows
then: No email is sent

cases.title: A restocked row loses its red highlight
cases.given: A row that the check highlighted red, and its Quantity is then raised above its Minimum
then: That row is no longer red

cases.title: A repeated product name is checked per row and listed as a problem
cases.given: Two rows with the same product name, one of them low
then: The low row is in the alert
Both rows are listed under "Rows with problems" as duplicate_product

cases.title: A missing or empty Stock tab sends one notice and no alert
cases.given: A sheet with no Stock tab, or a Stock tab with only the header row
then: One "sheet not found or empty" email is sent
No alert email is sent

cases.title: Running the check twice the same day sends at most one alert email
cases.given: One low product and an alert email already sent today
cases.when: The check runs again the same day
then: No second alert email is sent

cases.title: The Apps Script test file runs from the editor and reports results
cases.given: Code.gs and Tests.gs pasted into the sheet's Apps Script editor
cases.when: The user runs runAllTests from the editor
then: The log shows one PASS or FAIL line per test and a total
No Node.js is needed on the laptop
